prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic night scene depicting a massive bipedal police robot standing in the middle of a rain-slicked Tokyo intersection. The robot is constructed from heavy industrial machinery parts, featuring dark metallic joints and white armor plating with 'MPD' and '警視庁' (Metropolitan Police Department) markings on its chest and shoulders. It has a rectangular sensor head resembling a light bar and glowing red lights on its shoulders. Its right arm is raised high in a commanding 'stop' gesture, while its left hand holds a glowing orange traffic baton. In the foreground, a human police officer wearing a dark raincoat and helmet stands with his back to the camera, also holding an illuminated baton. To the right, a metal barricade sign displays the text '交通規制' (Traffic Control). The background features blurred city skyscrapers, streetlights, and a blue road sign indicating directions for Shinjuku and Yotsuya. Heavy rain streaks are visible throughout the air, reflecting off the wet asphalt pavement along with the red glow of police car lights.

promptZh: 一幅电影感十足的超写实夜景画面：一台巨大的双足警用机器人伫立在东京一处被雨水打湿的十字路口中央。机器人由重型工业机械部件拼装而成，关节呈暗色金属质感，白色装甲板上印有“MPD”与“警視庁”（东京都警视厅）标识，分布于胸部和肩部。它的头部为长方形传感器，形似车顶警示灯条，双肩处闪烁着红光。右臂高高举起，做出威严的“停止”手势；左手则握着一根发着橙光的交通指挥棒。前景中，一名身穿深色雨衣、头戴头盔的人类警察背对镜头站立，手中同样举着一根发光的指挥棒。画面右侧立着一块金属路障指示牌，上面写着“交通規制”（交通管制）。背景是虚化的城市摩天大楼、街灯，以及一块标示新宿与四谷方向的蓝色路牌。密集的雨丝划破夜空，与警车的红色闪光一同倒映在湿漉漉的柏油路面上。
